4 ادبقهُ He made it to stick, or adhere. (K. [See also 1.]) You say, ادبقهُ ٱللّٰهُ بِهِ (assumed tropical:) God made him, or may God make him, to stick to it; or, it to him. (JK, TA.) ―
-b2- مَا أَدْبَقَهُ (assumed tropical:) How great is his attachment, addictedness, or devotedness! (JK, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
